test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Assume that the information given in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, and decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement.

Statement:

Over the past year, respiratory illnesses have increased significantly in city W. According to a public health study, this increase is linked to the increase in the number of cars, which raises air pollution levels on the roads.

Conclusions:

I. Increased vehicular traffic contributes to higher levels of air pollution.

II. Improving public transportation will reduce respiratory illnesses in city W.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
__**Concept:**__

**Given Statements:**

__
 
• Respiratory illnesses have increased significantly in city W.
 
• A public health study links this increase to the rise in the number of cars, which raises air pollution levels on the roads.

**Conclusion I:**

“Increased vehicular traffic contributes to higher levels of air pollution.”

**Analysis:**

This is **directly stated** in the second sentence:

Increase in number of cars → raises air pollution levels on the roads.

**Status:** Conclusion I **follows**.

**Conclusion II:**

“Improving public transportation will reduce respiratory illnesses in city W.”

**Analysis:**

 
• The statements only establish a link: cars ↑ → pollution ↑ → respiratory illness ↑
 
• No mention is made of:
 
 
• public transportation
 
• policy measures
 
• solutions
 
• certainty of reduction
 
 
 
• This conclusion introduces a **new assumption** (solution-based inference).

**Status:** Conclusion II **does not follow**.

**Final Answer:**__

**Only Conclusion I follows.**
